agent-context.name: Coding Agent Context
agent-context.description: Manages coding agent context/instruction files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, copilot-instructions.md) with project-specific plan references and configurable markers
agent-context.author: spec-kit-core

archive.name: Archive Extension
archive.description: Archive merged features into main project memory, resolving gaps and conflicts.
archive.author: Stanislav Deviatov

assess.name: Idea Assessment Pipeline
assess.description: Assess an idea before Spec-Driven Development via intake, research, define, shape, and decide. A go verdict hands off to /speckit.specify; a kill closes it. Lives under .specify/assessments/<slug>/
assess.author: spec-kit-core

brownfield.name: Brownfield Bootstrap
brownfield.description: Bootstrap spec-kit for existing codebases — auto-discover architecture and adopt SDD incrementally
brownfield.author: Quratulain-bilal

bug.name: Bug Triage Workflow
bug.description: Assess, fix, and validate bug reports against the codebase with per-bug reports stored under .specify/bugs/<slug>/
bug.author: spec-kit-core

git.name: Git Branching Workflow
git.description: Feature branch creation, numbering (sequential/timestamp), validation, and Git remote detection
git.author: spec-kit-core

github.name: GitHub Integration
github.description: GitHub platform integration for Spec Kit - create GitHub issues from a feature's task list
github.author: spec-kit-core

memory.name: Spec Kit Memory
memory.description: Recall prior specs and decisions from configurable memory tools (memsearch, etc.) before SDLC stages
memory.author: Andrey Zaytsev
